# The Dragonbane fixtures as a deck

Every German card note in this folder — the English ones say
`language: en` and stay out — grouped in the order `card-type:` lists
them, the cover sheet first, because it is listed first. The creature card
type prints `large` on its own; `card-size:` here puts every card on
poker, one grid for the whole deck.

```cardsmith-deck
system: dragonbane
card-type: [generic, gear, creature, rule, roll-table]
card-languages: de
card-size: poker
paper-size: A4 portrait
```
